verified_note: UNVERIFIED. Written 2026-09-22 without access to SkySlope (egress-blocked from the build sandbox). Every url, list_path, read_path and login marker is a best-effort guess. On the first live run: `cli-anything-skyslope discover --url https://app.skyslope.com/` and correct this file, then `paths validate`.

transactions.note: One row per entry under the main landmark of the transactions list. Expect to narrow list_path to the table or list node after discover.

transaction-detail.note: Summary page of one transaction: rows are the child nodes, text is the main landmark read in full.

document-index.note: Document NAMES only. This harness has no download verb; a download would land client PII on disk.

checklist-status.note: Rows are checklist items; matches are the ones DOMShell grep finds for the pattern (default 'Incomplete'). Tune the pattern to the real wording after discover.
